source: Current Android 17 ColorOS port; approved normal Android getprop and active A vendor RO export
rationale: build-19 metadata begin KEY_REQUIRES_UPGRADE then upgrade INVALID_ARGUMENT; KeyMint interface rejects downgrade of OS/patch binding; target system values from normal Android are newer than recovery defaults. Configure INVALID_TAG remains a separate observed error, not a proven sole cause.
scope: Vendor patch and two measured system identity properties only; no future values, OS_VERSION=0, platform SDK or AVB rollback modification
system_property_scope: Rewrite only recovery prop.default before packaging and before QTI HAL constructor; do not change build SDK/API/release flags or boot image/AVB version metadata
